title: I'm not sure it does anything
text:
I'm not sure it does anything. The idea is simple. These cleaning pods are designed to fit into a Nespresso classic machine and by running a couple of brewing cycles, the machine should be cleaner.

I found that the YEGEE Powerful Cleaning Pods and Capsules Cleaner Kit were easy to use. I had no trouble following the directions on the box and it was quick. I just don't know if it did anything. The water that came out didn't seem to bring out any coffee residue.

The coffee doesn't taste any different and the machine still runs the same before and after the cleaning.
